label: Pinterest Catalogs
terms_note: Pinterest business account per tenant with a catalog (verified merchant status for full shopping features); our app starts in trial access (1,000 requests / day across all endpoints) and needs Pinterest's app review for standard access (100 requests / s per user per app); scopes catalogs:read + catalogs:write; product data per Pinterest catalog spec; no checkout on Pinterest — clicks land on the storefront.

discovery.auth: oauth2 (Pinterest app; scopes catalogs:read + catalogs:write; trial access by default, standard access after app review)

rate_limits: Trial 1,000 requests/day; Standard 100 requests/s per user per app, plus per-category limits

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes**.Confidence: **high** — official developer documentation opened by the auditor.
auth: 1. Create a Pinterest app (trial access) → client id + secret; request standard access via app review for production volumes.
2. Tenant authorises with scopes catalogs:read catalogs:write (+ ads scopes if Shopping ads are wanted) → access + refresh tokens.
3. Create / select the user's RETAIL catalog; push items via batch or register a feed URL.

endpoints.notes: catalog_type RETAIL, country, language, items[{item_id, title, description, link, image_link, price, sale_price, availability, condition, brand, …}], update_mask → batch_id

reference.limits: Trial: 1,000 requests / day for all endpoints. Standard: 100 requests / second per user per app; category-specific limits for ads / analytics; x-ratelimit-limit / remaining / reset headers; raise via support ticket. - Pinterest Developer Terms + Merchant Guidelines; app review for standard access. - No checkout / orders on Pinterest.

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: Pinterest app id; HTTP Basic username on POST https://api.pinterest.com/v5/oauth/token.

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: Pinterest app secret key; HTTP Basic password on the token request.

fields.name: refresh_token
fields.help: Refresh token from the authorization-code flow with scopes user_accounts:read, catalogs:read and catalogs:write (apps have trial access until Pinterest grants standard access). Continuous refresh tokens rotate on every refresh: the runtime keeps the new one and, with PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR set, saves it to <dir>/pinterest_catalogs.json (0600).

config_fields.name: country
config_fields.help: Two-letter country of the catalog items, e.g. US.

config_fields.name: language
config_fields.help: Language of the catalog items, e.g. en-US or EN.

config_fields.name: currency
config_fields.help: ISO currency appended to prices ('24.99 USD'); required when update_listing sends a price.

adapter.terms: Pinterest API v5 catalogs. Item batches are processed asynchronously (GET /catalogs/items/batch/{batch_id}); the UPSERT/CREATE item operations are restricted for merchants that ingest through a feed.

me.note: user_account/get: {account_type, username, id, business_name} of the token user.

update_listing.note: items_batch/post with one RETAIL item {item_id, operation: UPDATE, attributes: {title, description, price: '<amount> <currency>'}} and no update_mask, so only the attributes sent are changed. `listing_id` is the catalog item id in your namespace. Asynchronous: status PROCESSING|COMPLETED|FAILED, raw.batch_id and per-item errors. Pinterest has no stock quantity (only availability), so `quantity` is not applied.

end_listing.note: items_batch/post DELETE removes the item from the catalog (and its product Pins); not reversible. Asynchronous batch.

not_offered.create_listing: A RETAIL item CREATE requires link, image_link, availability, condition and google_product_category-style attributes besides title/price, and CREATE/UPSERT is restricted for merchants with a feed data source; the vocabulary has no product link.
not_offered.set_inventory: Pinterest catalog items carry an availability state ('in stock' | 'out of stock' | 'preorder'), not a stock quantity.
not_offered.list_orders: Pinterest catalogs have no orders; checkout happens on the merchant's site.
not_offered.mark_shipped: No orders or shipments in the Pinterest API.

evidence: host api.pinterest.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (DigiCert Inc)
probe: 3/3 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route answered 401 too, so the host authenticates before routing
spec https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pinterest/api-description/main/v5/openapi.yaml: 3/3 tools match (path, method, parameters, body keys, response paths)
auth_audit.notes: POST /v5/oauth/token answered 500 code 12 for a numeric dummy client id and 401 'Authentication failed' for a non-numeric one (checked by hand), so the token endpoint is live; the 500 is Pinterest's handling of an unknown app id.
